title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
statement: Return the node values level by level, top to bottom and left to right within each level. An empty tree returns an empty list.
hints: This is breadth-first search with one extra detail: you must know where each level ends.
Before draining the queue, record its current Count. That count is exactly the width of the current level.
Process precisely that many nodes into one list, enqueuing children as you go, then start the next level.
